ITEM 1. BUSINESS
We believe that a cloud computing platform that puts data and artificial intelligence (AI) at its core will offer great benefits to organizations by allowing them to realize the value of the data that powers their businesses. By offering rich primitives for data and applications, we believe that we can create a data connected world where organizations have seamless access to explore, share, and unlock the value of data. To realize this vision, we deliver the AI Data Cloud, a network where Snowflake customers, partners, developers, data providers, and data consumers can break down data silos and derive value from a growing number of data sets in secure, governed, and compliant ways.
Our platform is the innovative technology that powers the AI Data Cloud, enabling customers to consolidate data into a single source of truth to drive meaningful insights, apply AI to solve business problems, build data applications, and share data and data products. We provide our platform through a customer-centric, consumption-based business model, only charging customers for the resources they use.

I have sufficient evidence from the FY2025 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended January 31, 2025).

## Major strategic product and technology initiatives — Snowflake Inc. (CIK 1640147)

Source: FY2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K, report period ended **2025-01-31** (`data/filings/1640147/snow-20250131.htm`). The FY2024 10-K (ended 2024-01-31) is consistent on the same themes.

**1. The "AI Data Cloud" as the central strategic vision.** The company frames its platform as the technology powering the AI Data Cloud — a network of customers, partners, developers, data providers and consumers — and says it intends to "invest in our business to advance the AI Data Cloud through the adoption of our platform" (chunk 1640147/snow-20250131:62400; also 48000).

**2. AI / machine learning technology (Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowflake ML).** AI is the most emphasized initiative. The platform's AI category covers Document AI and Cortex LLM Functions (NLP on unstructured data), Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search (conversational assistants), and Snowflake ML plus Snowpark Container Services (GPU-powered managed compute) for training/deploying LLMs and ML models (chunk 68800, 70400). The company states it is "investing significantly in AI Technology," including internally developing AI, acquiring companies with complementary AI, and partnering (chunk 110400). It also announced **Snowflake Intelligence** in 2024 to let customers create data agents (chunk 51200).

**3. Snowpark and developer/programming-language expansion.** Snowpark (Java/Scala in 2021, Python in 2022) and Snowpark Container Services (2023) are highlighted as bringing multiple languages and containerized AI workloads onto the platform (chunk 51200).

**4. Native Application Framework and applications.** The company continues to invest in its Native Application program so companies can build, operate and market applications inside the AI Data Cloud, and to enable Snowflake-native applications (chunks 51200, 70400).

**5. Data collaboration / Snowflake Marketplace.** Secure data sharing, monetization and acquisition of live data, applications and AI products via the Marketplace and internal marketplaces (chunk 70400).

**6. Industry-vertical AI Data Clouds.** Tailored go-to-market solutions such as the AI Data Cloud for Financial Services, Advertising, and others (chunk 51200).

**7. R&D and feature cadence.** The company says it will "continue making significant investments in research and development and hiring top technical talent." During FY2025, Iceberg tables, hybrid tables, notebooks, Internal Marketplace, Universal Search, Document AI, Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowflake ML became generally available, while lineage visualization, Snowflake Open Catalog, ML Operations, AI model sharing and model explainability entered public preview, expected to reach GA in FY2026 (chunk 62400).

**8. Partnerships and ecosystem.** The Snowflake Partner Network spans channel partners, system integrators, data providers, applications, AI solutions and technology partners (chunk 83200).

**Limitations:** These are the company's stated strategies and product plans as described in the 10-K; forward-looking items (e.g., public-preview features expected to become generally available in FY2026) are plans, not confirmed results. The report also flags execution risk — e.g., dependence on GPU access and customer adoption of AI Technology (chunk 110400). No numeric financial figures were needed for this qualitative question.
